title: Churachandpur Police Seize 6.878 Kg of Opium, Arrest Three
summary: Churachandpur Police seize approximately 6.878 kg of suspected opium during a search at Lajangphai Village and arrest three persons, including the house owner.
body:
Imphal, October 30, 2026: Churachandpur Police seized approximately 6.878 kg of suspected opium and arrested three persons, including the house owner, during an operation at Lajangphai Village on Friday.

Acting on specific intelligence inputs, police conducted a search at the residence of Letminthang Haokip, 38, of Lajangphai Village, Churachandpur district.

During the search, approximately 6.878 kg of opium was recovered. Three persons were arrested in connection with the seizure.

Three Persons Arrested

The arrested individuals have been identified as:

Letminthang Haokip (38) of Lajangphai Village, Churachandpur.

Nemneihoi Haokip (35) of Phaimol Village, Singngat Sub-Division, currently residing at Gamnomjang Village, Churachandpur.

Chinneikim (29) of Leisan Village, Sugnu, Chandel district, currently residing at Sijang Village, Churachandpur.

Police said further investigation is underway in connection with the case.
